gloss: to bend backward; to warp; to curve

definitions.gloss: to bend backward, to arch back
definitions.explanation: For a person or body part to bend or lean backward, forming an arch shape.

definitions.gloss: to warp, to curve, to buckle
definitions.explanation: For a flat object such as wood or paper to become curved or bent out of its original flat shape, typically due to heat, moisture, or age.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反|そ}らす→反らす：20852_sorasu⟧ (arch one's body back)
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反|そ}らす→反らす：20852_sorasu⟧ (puff out one's chest)
- ⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反|そ}らす→反らす：20852_sorasu⟧ (arch one's back)
- ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{反|そ}る (a board warps)

USAGE:
The intransitive form {反|そ}る describes something bending on its own, while the transitive form ⟦{反|そ}らす→反らす：20852_sorasu⟧ means to bend something backward deliberately. ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反|そ}らす→反らす：20852_sorasu⟧ is an idiomatic expression meaning to puff out one's chest with pride or confidence. Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧ (to shave).
